blurb: Summarise the week's completed work and draft a review note.

definition.name: Weekly review
definition.description: Pulls this week's Done cards and recent notes, then drafts a review note.
definition.instructions: Look at the project's board activity for this week. Summarise what was completed (Done cards), what's still open, and any patterns worth noting. Then write a concise review note titled 'Weekly review — <date>' with sections: Completed, In progress, Blocked, and Next week. Keep it tight and factual.
